exposure: Previously used development, diagnostic and evaluated prospective questions; not a blind holdout.

cases.query: According to the README, what should I run to see the coverage report even if coverage fails?
cases.expectation: Command exactly mvn clean site -Dcommons.jacoco.haltOnFailure=false -Pjacoco; report even if coverage fails.

witness.text:
+ Provide JUnit tests for your changes and make sure your changes don't break any existing tests by running `mvn`.
+ Before you push a PR, run `mvn` (without arguments). This runs the default goal which contains all build checks.
+ To see the code coverage report, regardless of coverage failures, run `mvn clean site -Dcommons.jacoco.haltOnFailure=false -Pjacoco`

cases.query: What exact minimum Java version does the README state is required to build the project?
cases.expectation: No numeric minimum stated in README; it points to maven.compiler.source in pom.xml. Abstain from inventing a number. README full text lines 1-119 was inspected.

witness.text:
Building
--------

Building requires a Java JDK and [Apache Maven](https://maven.apache.org/).
The required Java version is found in the `pom.xml` as the `maven.compiler.source` property.

From a command shell, run `mvn` without arguments to invoke the default Maven goal to run all tests and checks.

absence.description: numeric Java version in the complete README

cases.query: In OptionGroup, what happens if I select a different option after one is already selected, reselect the same option, or pass null?
cases.expectation: Different option throws AlreadySelectedException; same key reselection accepted; null clears selection.

cases.query: Dans OptionGroup, que se passe-t-il si je sélectionne une autre option après une première sélection, si je resélectionne la même, ou si je passe null ?
cases.expectation: Different option throws AlreadySelectedException; same key reselection accepted; null clears selection.

cases.query: When a chained name transformer applies two transformations, in what order are they applied, and what happens during reversal if the first reverse fails?
cases.expectation: Forward applies t2 then t1; reverse applies t1 first and calls t2 only if t1 returned non-null; otherwise returns null.

cases.query: When an LRUMap is serialized and restored, what happens to its cached entries and which sizing information is retained?
cases.expectation: Cached contents are not serialized; initial and maximum sizing are retained and a new empty LRUMap is constructed on readResolve. Additional witnesses lines 32-45 and 90-92.

witness.text:
/** * Converts a String to a {@link Class}. Calls {@link Class#forName(String, boolean, ClassLoader)} with {@code initialize} set to {@code false} so that * resolving the name does not by itself trigger the class's static initializer. *

* The value can name any class visible to the class loader of this library. Do not apply this converter, the default for options of type {@link Class}, * to values from an untrusted source. *

*/ Converter, ClassNotFoundException> CLASS = s -> Class.forName(s, false, Converter.class.getClassLoader());
